purpose: Teach: 緒方/たたえ/東山/江口/徳永/関根/井出/新党

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、指導教授の緒方先生のご研究を継承しろ
lines.en: Ren — carry forward the research of your advisor, Professor Ogata.
lines.style: Direct, measured instruction. Clear weight on Ren's name to catch his attention. Warm certainty underneath — he trusts Ren with this. Steady eye contact, no doubt.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。優れた論文をたたえる学会賞を目指します
lines.en: Yes. I'm going to aim for the academic award that honors excellent papers.
lines.style: Formal, respectful reply. Slight hesitation on the opening 'Yes' — gathering himself to match the gravity of the charge. Earnest and deliberate, not rushed.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、京都東山地区の伝統工芸の論文を読め
lines.en: Ren — read the paper on traditional crafts in Kyoto's Higashiyama district.
lines.style: Another clear directive. Ren's name again — this is guidance, not suggestion. Slightly quicker than the first line, building a sequence of tasks. Practical, focused.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。学会で江口助教のご発表を聴きます
lines.en: Yes. I'll listen to Assistant Professor Eguchi's presentation at the conference.
lines.style: Quick acknowledgment. Shows he's keeping pace with the instructions. Still respectful, but the replies are getting a rhythm — he's ready to receive. No hesitation this time.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、文献の徳永先生のご論文も参考にしろ
lines.en: Ren — also refer to Professor Tokunaga's papers in your literature review.
lines.style: Third task, same authoritative clarity. Slightly warmer — Hiroshi is building out a pathway for Ren. 'Also' suggests these are pieces of a whole. Composed, teaching.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。研究室の関根先輩からご指導を仰ぎます
lines.en: Yes. I'll ask my senior colleague Sekine in the lab for guidance.
lines.style: Respectful affirmation. The politeness deepens slightly here — asking others requires humility. Steady, obedient, showing he understands the collaborative nature of research.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、海外連携の井出教授と打ち合わせしろ
lines.en: Ren — meet with Professor Ide from our overseas partnership program.
lines.style: Final directive. A slight shift in tone — this is a step outward, toward the international. Still clear and authoritative, but with a hint of expansion, opening doors.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。新党、つまり新党結成の政治学論文を読みます
lines.en: Yes. I'll read the political science papers on the formation of new political parties.
lines.style: Final confirmation. He's understood the full scope now. The line has a slight sense of closure — comprehensive, clear-eyed. Respectful but confident, like he's ready to begin.
